dictNoticeSocketing.enUS:
- You cannot add sockets superior item with Horadric Cube.
- Max number of sockets varies by item type and item level.
- When removing an item socketed in, the items in the sockets will disappear.
dictNoticeSocketing.zhCN:
- 劣質或超強裝備不能使用公式打孔
- 最大孔數取決於裝備類型和物品等級
- 移除鑲孔中的物品會摧毀已經鑲嵌的寶石,符文或珠寶.

dictNoticeUpgrade.enUS:
- Upgrading will lead to increased equipment requirements.
- There is a +5 modifier to the base level req when upgrading normal -> exceptional.
- There is a +7 modifier to the base level req when upgrading exceptional -> elite.
dictNoticeUpgrade.zhCN:
- 升級將導致裝備需求增加.
- 當一件裝備從 普通級 升級為 擴展級 基礎需求等級+5
- 當一件裝備從 擴展級 升級為 精英級 基礎需求等級+7.
